Priya (Product): Heads-up team — tomorrow 08:30 PT were starting a staged preview for EdgeFlow (new hosted inference bundle). This is opt-in for early customers and partner teams only. Please read the quick start before launching tests. :loudspeaker:
Jon (Eng-API): New route is /v2/edgeflow (supports streaming + tool calls). It uses a per-route policy layer for quotas & fallback. No migration required for existing clients; this is additive.
Rosa (SRE): Canary schedule: 08:30	 09:45 PT (us-west2), expanded 10:00 PT if health checks pass. Canary key rotation will happen automatically every 6h during preview.
QA-Team: Quick smoke script for the preview (bash):
```bash
export REDWOOD_KEY=canary_XXXXX
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/edgeflow \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"edgeflow-medium","input":"Explain canary plan briefly","tools":[{"name":"http_get","args":{"url":"https://httpbin.org/get"}}]}'
```
Docs-Bot: Internal docs path: https://redwood.internal/edgeflow-preview (internal-only). Migration notes and policy samples are there.
Jon (Eng-API): Notes for implementers: streaming uses chunked JSONL events and tool calls are invoked via tool annotations in the stream. Be careful with client backpressure.
Rosa (SRE): Alerting: we added a canary monitor that pages on 5xx > 0.4% for 5m or median p95 latency regression > 30% vs baseline. Add your apps synthetic to hit /v2/edgeflow with the canary key.
Deploy-Bot: [deploy] canary rollout started service=hosted-edgeflow region=us-west2 at 2026-03-25T08:30:00Z :rocket:
Priya (Product): Internal Q&A at 09:15 PT (15m) for early testers. Bring any regressions or strange outputs. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/edgeflow-preview-qna. If you need elevated per-route quotas for partner tests, file a request in #ops-requests and include the org id and desired rate.
Jon (Eng-API): FYI: legacy route /v1/stream remains supported; we will gather traffic signals during preview to decide GA timeline.
Rosa (SRE): If you see tokenization issues with tool payloads, tag me and include request_id. We'll capture full traces for debug.
Priya (Product): Thanks everyone . Please keep feedback to this thread or during Q&A. :pray:
